quarterly_data.quarter: INNIO press release: INNIO and Aggreko Extend Strategic Partnership Through (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Aggreko (described in the release as a global leader in engineered energy and temperature solutions): INNIO substantially extended its long-standing strategic partnership, now running through 2031, securing substantial long-term engine capacity for Aggreko and giving INNIO additional order visibility for medium-power range engines. INNIO agreed to provide a minimum of 450 MW of engine capacity in the medium-power range (Jenbacher Type 4, including the J420 and J424) in 2027, with access to agreed capacity levels for the remainder of the agreement; the partnership now also includes supply of the J620 engine from 2028, plus a multi-year service agreement covering Aggreko's existing INNIO fleet. The company says these engines are particularly well suited to Aggreko's mobile equipment fleet, enabling fast deployment across data centers and a wide range of industrial and critical power applications. CEO Olaf Berlien: 'Global power demand is rising rapidly, while grid constraints are growing.'
quarterly_data.figure: minimum 450 MW of Type 4 engine capacity in 2027; agreement through 2031; J620 supply from 2028
